title: TWIST power leg: VHigh overvoltage and overcurrent

tabs.title: Field failures
tabs.question: Do the reported field failures follow from the energy paths of the leg when nothing protects it?
notes: Unprotected cases are expected to FAIL: a FAIL here reproduces a field failure in the model. They are marked known against finding F-1 or F-2.

tabs.title: Safe cases
tabs.question: Which disconnects and supply losses are harmless? These bound the hypothesis: they must PASS.

tabs.title: Protections
tabs.question: Which protection keeps Vds(Q201) under 150 V and |iL| under 40 A in the failing cases? Includes the active clamp proposed on the schematic.

tabs.title: Bench (L2)
tabs.question: Does the board behave like the model? Each bench test runs through bench/bench_wizard.sh and is compared with its D-L2P prediction.
notes: Firmware: ~/code/examples branch vhigh-investigation, TWIST/DC_DC/vhigh_investigation, built with Core main. Its bench guard (80 V, 2 A, latched, 100 us) protects the test, not the board.

findings.title: Energy returned to VHigh has no sink: the lab supply cannot absorb current and nothing stops the PWM on VHigh overvoltage
No current limit and no duty slew limit: a large duty step rings L201 against the low-side capacitors
The drain-gate active clamp has to burn all the returned power in Q201

field_failures.what: Ownverter skateboard: heavy pilot, drove away from the supply, cable pulled out; high-side FETs dead
TWIST feeding a load, supply switched off; FETs dead
field_failures.note: Harmless in the model unless the load returns energy (electronic load, battery, motor) or a voltage loop was running: to be clarified.

field_failures.what: Ownverter: supply disconnected before the low side was powered down
Too large a duty-cycle step: high-side FET dead

field_failures.note: No case yet: needs the operating point.

tests.title: Boost 8 A into VHigh, supply cable pulled at 2 ms
tests.purpose: Power flows from the low side to VHigh under current control. The supply absorbs it while connected; once the cable is pulled, the ~140 uF of VHigh is the only sink.

tests.title: Boost 8 A into VHigh, lab supply connected (cannot sink)
tests.purpose: Same power flow with a real lab supply: it cannot sink current, so VHigh rises even with the cable in place.

tests.title: Boost 2 A into VHigh, lab supply connected (cannot sink)
tests.purpose: A light reverse current: how fast the bus still rises.

tests.title: Skateboard braking at 8 A, lab supply connected
tests.purpose: Motor and rider as an equivalent 3 F capacitor at 48 V (kinetic energy). Braking returns 8 A to VHigh.

tests.title: Skateboard braking at 25 A (heavy pilot), lab supply connected
tests.purpose: A heavier pilot means more braking current for the same deceleration: 25 A returned to VHigh.

tests.title: Open-loop duty step 0.2 to 0.8 at 1 ms
tests.purpose: L201 against 60 uF on the low side (Z0 = 0.74 ohm, 3.6 kHz): a 60 V step across the tank.

tests.title: Open-loop duty step 0.8 to 0.2 at 1 ms
tests.purpose: The step down: the current reverses and the low-side energy rings back into VHigh.

tests.title: Buck 8 A under current control, cable pulled at 2 ms
tests.purpose: Power flows towards the low side: VHigh is drained, the duty saturates, the Feeder stops below 8.9 V.

tests.title: Fixed duty 0.486 (8 A buck), battery on the low side, supply off at 2 ms
tests.purpose: Open loop the leg is a DC transformer: VHigh settles at V_low/d, about where the supply was.

tests.title: Fixed duty 0.48, resistive load 6 ohm, supply off at 2 ms
tests.purpose: Passive load: nothing returns energy, VHigh decays.

tests.title: Skateboard motoring at fixed duty 0.49 (8 A), cable pulled at 2 ms
tests.purpose: Driving away (motoring, not braking) when the cable pulls: the motor back-EMF holds VHigh near V_low/d.

tests.title: Open-loop duty step 0.4 to 0.6 at 1 ms
tests.purpose: A moderate step: how much current overshoot remains.

tests.title: D-DIS-01 + firmware OV trip at 110 V, 1 ms latency
tests.purpose: A slow software check (ADC polled in a background task).

tests.title: D-DIS-01 + OV trip at 110 V, 100 us latency
tests.purpose: An ADC watchdog checked in the control interrupt.

tests.title: D-DIS-01 + hardware OV trip at 110 V, 5 us
tests.purpose: A comparator into the HRTIM fault input (ADR 0009 path).

tests.title: D-SKT-02 (25 A braking) + hardware OV trip at 110 V, 5 us
tests.purpose: The worst regen case with the hardware trip.

tests.title: D-SKT-02 (25 A braking) + firmware OV trip at 110 V, 1 ms
tests.purpose: Is a slow software trip enough at high braking current?

tests.title: D-STP-01 with the duty slew limited to 0.1 per ms
tests.purpose: A rate limiter on the duty command: the 0.6 step takes 6 ms, much longer than the 280 us tank period.

tests.title: D-STP-01 with a cycle-by-cycle current limit at 20 A
tests.purpose: Peak current limit cutting each period short (comparator on the inductor current).

tests.title: Proposed active clamp at 130 V on D-SKT-02 (25 A braking)
tests.purpose: The drain-gate zener clamp of the schematic: Q201 conducts in its linear region to hold VHigh at 130 V. Where does the energy go?

tests.title: Proposed active clamp at 130 V on D-DIS-01 (8 A boost, cable pulled)
tests.purpose: The same clamp on the lighter case.

tests.title: VHigh collapse drives the duty to 100%: bootstrap starvation of the high-side gate drive
tests.purpose: Needs a gate-drive and bootstrap model (UCC21222, R219 4.7 k discharge); not in the averaged model.

tests.title: Prediction for L2-OV-01: 0.5 A into VHigh, 32 V supply, 100 ohm bleed
tests.purpose: The bench setup of L2-OV-01: low-side supply 12 V, VHigh lab supply 32 V (cannot sink), 100 ohm across VHigh, both legs' VHigh capacitors (276 uF). Current reference -0.5 A. Above 0.85 A the injected power exceeds what the resistor draws at 32 V, so VHigh settles above the set point at about sqrt(P*R).

tests.title: Prediction for L2-OV-01: 1 A into VHigh, 32 V supply, 100 ohm bleed
tests.purpose: The bench setup of L2-OV-01: low-side supply 12 V, VHigh lab supply 32 V (cannot sink), 100 ohm across VHigh, both legs' VHigh capacitors (276 uF). Current reference -1 A. Above 0.85 A the injected power exceeds what the resistor draws at 32 V, so VHigh settles above the set point at about sqrt(P*R).

tests.title: Prediction for L2-OV-01: 1.25 A into VHigh, 32 V supply, 100 ohm bleed
tests.purpose: The bench setup of L2-OV-01: low-side supply 12 V, VHigh lab supply 32 V (cannot sink), 100 ohm across VHigh, both legs' VHigh capacitors (276 uF). Current reference -1.25 A. Above 0.85 A the injected power exceeds what the resistor draws at 32 V, so VHigh settles above the set point at about sqrt(P*R).

tests.title: Prediction for L2-OV-01: 1.5 A into VHigh, 32 V supply, 100 ohm bleed
tests.purpose: The bench setup of L2-OV-01: low-side supply 12 V, VHigh lab supply 32 V (cannot sink), 100 ohm across VHigh, both legs' VHigh capacitors (276 uF). Current reference -1.5 A. Above 0.85 A the injected power exceeds what the resistor draws at 32 V, so VHigh settles above the set point at about sqrt(P*R).

tests.title: Prediction for L2-OV-02: 2.0 A into VHigh with the 100 ohm bleed, firmware stop at 45 V
tests.purpose: At 2.0 A the injected power (24 W) would settle VHigh at about 48.7 V: the example's software stop (100 us control task) opens the leg at 45 V, then the bleed resistor brings VHigh back to the 32 V supply.

tests.title: Prediction for L2-STP-01: duty step 0.4 to 0.5 at VHigh = 30 V, 10 ohm load
tests.purpose: Open-loop step at low energy: 3 V across the L201 / low-side capacitor tank. The low-side capacitance (60 uF) is an assumption to check against the capture.

tests.title: Board sensors V_HIGH and V1_LOW against a meter at the board terminals, PWM off
tests.purpose: Every session starts with it (stage 6). It catches a supply left at another set point and the sensor gain errors: V1_LOW reads about 4 % high on the bench board, which is what made the first current loop run away.

tests.title: Boost 0.5 to 1.5 A into VHigh with the lab supply at 32 V and a 100 ohm bleed: VHigh settles above the set point
tests.purpose: Confirms F-1 on the board without any disconnect. 12 V supply (3 A limit) on LOW1, 100 ohm / 30 W across VHigh, MSO54 on VHigh, V1_low, iL, SW. Pass band: each settled VHigh within the D-L2P-01..04 prediction +/-5 %. Firmware: examples TWIST/DC_DC/vhigh_investigation, CURRENT mode.

tests.title: Duty step 0.4 to 0.5 at VHigh = 30 V, 10 ohm load: inductor current overshoot
tests.purpose: Confirms F-2 at low energy; current probe on L201; compare peak and ringing frequency with D-L2P-06. Firmware STEP mode, firmware scope triggered on the step.

tests.title: 2.0 A into VHigh with the bleed: VHigh rises from 32 V until the example's 45 V software stop opens the leg
tests.purpose: Measures the rise (compare with D-L2P-05) and checks the stop latches with its reason readable, then VHigh falls back to 32 V through the bleed. A test guard only, not the hardware fix.
